risk_if_not_implemented: Without Chip-To-Cloud Security, embedded and IoT technologies may operate with unknown, insecure or unmonitored configurations, creating exploitable footholds. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Operational Technology (OT) / Industrial Control System (ICS) Attack (MT-30).

compensating_control_1.name: Use of Cryptographic Controls
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of cryptographic protections controls using known public standards and trusted cryptographic technologies.
compensating_control_1.justification: Use of Cryptographic Controls (CRY-02) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Chip-To-Cloud Security (EMB-21) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Boundary Protection
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to monitor and control communications at the external network boundary and at key internal boundaries within the network.
compensating_control_2.justification: Boundary Protection (NET-03) provides network-level access restriction that compensates for the absence of Chip-To-Cloud Security (EMB-21) by limiting attacker reach and lateral movement opportunities across the environment. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
